tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page canvas behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and table rows raised on the background.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs above a surface.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on background and surface.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and placeholders on background and surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one brand colour: primary buttons, links, active states and focus.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tinted fills behind accent text: hover states, selected rows, soft chips.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input borders and control outlines: 3:1 against the surfaces.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers; decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on background, surface or successBackground.

tokens.name: success-background
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind success text.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: The boundary of a success chip or banner.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on background, surface or warningBackground.

tokens.name: warning-background
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: The boundary of a warning chip or banner.

tokens.name: danger-foreground
tokens.usage: Danger text, destructive actions and invalid input borders.

tokens.name: danger-background
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind danger text.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: The boundary of a danger chip or banner.

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons on background, surface or infoBackground.

tokens.name: info-background
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind informational text.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: The boundary of an informational chip or banner.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field labels and badge text.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Legal text and the smallest annotations.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Control labels that lead: buttons, tabs, table headers.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense running text: tables, lists, secondary panels.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page-level statements; one per screen.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The small uppercase line above a heading. Set in uppercase.

spacing.note: One scale for padding, gaps and margins; nothing else is used.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No space.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label; inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections; around a hero.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above and below a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and landing-section breathing room.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The widest break between landing sections.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs and the sample page frame.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges and small controls.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero media and large featured surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, swatches and inline marks.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Square corners: tables, full-bleed panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars, toggles and status dots.

shadow.note: Elevation on light surfaces; dark surfaces layer with surface and surface-overlay instead.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards and panels.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring on every control; never removed.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and floating action bars.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on hover and dragged items.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs.

control.note: Control heights and the layout widths the components are sized to.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary calls to action and touch targets.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: The default control height.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and inputs inside tables and toolbars.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Hero actions.

tokens.name: control-rail
tokens.usage: The side navigation width.

tokens.name: control-top-bar
tokens.usage: The header height.

tokens.name: control-content-max
tokens.usage: The widest a page body grows.

tokens.name: control-utility-bar
tokens.usage: The secondary bar under the header.
